title: Recyclarr CLI Settings
description: Optional settings for the recyclarr command line client (cli.yml). The server reads settings.yml instead.

server.title: How the CLI reaches a Recyclarr server

base_url.title: Address of an already-running Recyclarr server
base_url.description: When set, commands send their work to this server instead of starting a private one. Use this to point the CLI at a 'recyclarr serve' instance, a container, or a Kubernetes deployment. A non-empty RECYCLARR_SERVER_URL environment variable overrides this value.

api_key.title: Server API key sent to the server at base_url
api_key.description: Must match the RECYCLARR_API_KEY environment variable of that server. Not used without base_url, because the CLI gives the server it starts a one-time key. A non-empty RECYCLARR_API_KEY environment variable overrides this value.
